learning_outcomes.text: Understand the principles of Boolean logic and algorithms.
Examine electronics through analysing and designing basic combinational digital circuits.
Identify sequential digital circuits and applications.
Apply the knowledge in digital electronic circuit design

syllabus_topics: Boolean expression from logic diagrams and truth tables
Truth tables from logic diagrams and Boolean expressions
Loading Karnaugh map from a truth table
Applications of Karnaugh map: multiple output networks, decoders, code conversion network
Edge triggered SR, D-type, J-K Flip-Flops
Digital Counters: asynchronous and synchronous counters concept
Shift Registers: serial shift registers, serial in-parallel out shift registers, bidirectional shift registers
Use CAD tools to carry out circuit design and simulation
institution: Liverpool John Moores University — BEng (Hons) Electrical and Electronic Engineering
